description: Cerema publishes the standard statistical results and supporting metadata for the mobility survey identified as Arras, 2024. The source identifies the Arras survey and its standard statistical results. The full native description lists a survey identity sheet and result tables, with a table index specifying variables, geographic level, filters and weighting coefficients. Supporting material includes GIS survey boundaries, sampled municipalities and sampling sectors, correspondence tables between geographic divisions, travel-mode and trip-purpose classifications, the hierarchy used to determine a trip’s main mode, the questionnaire and definitions of indicators. Smaller surveys may use a different grouping of sampling sectors. These transport-specific variables and spatial divisions support representation of travel demand in network-flow research. That use is a bounded interpretation of the described information; the listing does not establish an executed or calibrated traffic simulation. The native inventory lists compressed result packages and PDF documentation under Open Licence 2.0. File contents, actual statistical tables, sampling precision, joins and current download availability have not been inspected. Related Cerema methodological references are listed in the description; linked documents have not been read. No executable model or separate simulation platform is established.
